1.name: Recuperative Treatise
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3681|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6495|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff2864|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2943|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10115|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Echoing Vigor
4.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff14958|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

5.name: Concealed Weapon
5.description:
Slash an enemy, dealing |cffffff8099|r Magic Damage. 

If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance.

When you leave Sneak or invisibility while in combat, increase your damage done with this ability by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff15|r seconds.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3442|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff3578|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff1508|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1621|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5325|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Echoing Vigor
4.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff7866|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

5.name: The Tide King's Gaze
5.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff1896|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff5110|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

2.name: Twilight Matriarch Restore
2.description:
Call on Azura to send a twilight matriarch to fight at your side. The twilight matriarch's zap deals |cffffff2078|r Shock Damage and its kick deals |cffffff2078|r Shock Damage.

Once summoned, you can activate the twilight matriarch's special ability for |cffffff3718|r Magicka, causing it to heal |cffffff2|r friendly targets for |cffffff20089|r and itself for |cffffff10043|r.

The twilight matriarch remains until killed or unsummoned.

3.name: Equilibrium
3.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

4.name: Degeneration
4.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff28608|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

5.name: Inner Light
5.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Shooting Star
6.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff25572|r Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff6931|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.
